claim: the 50/50 shrinking/expanding balance (mu=0.5) yields 'total truth': simultaneously the layout optimum and the robust recovery optimum
verdict: PARTIAL: the 50/50 state is the best shock ABSORBER (recovers to 95-100% of a fresh same-size packing; n4 re-anchor matches the fresh lattice; the tight-core n2 mu=0.9 tier shatters) but is NOT the layout optimum - best packing sits at mu=0.25, best uniformity at mu=0.0, and pure repulsion wins routing decisively (base_route 0.960 vs 0.887 balanced; old-class routing after +5 degrades slower without balance). Truth-as-layout-optimum and truth-as-robust-recovery are different optima and do not coincide.
